row.body: A food bag is tied to the pantry key with a note to leave one portion for the next shift. The kitchen list says the garden delivery never arrived.
row.title: Food left for later

sidecar.gloss: A shift meal is saved while a garden delivery remains missing.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency distribution could have interrupted a routine food delivery; the missing bag does not show why it failed.

row.body: the eraser and hand torch share two stains: sweet field residue below and bleach above. both could have been packed during either job.
row.title: two traces on the eraser

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
